src: const k = sketch('top'); k.rect(60, 40, { at: [0, 0] }); const t = extrude(k, 30); const sk = sketch('top'); sk.polygon([[15.7,13.8],[23.4,13.8],[20.3,20.5],[15.7,20.5]]); groove(sk, t, 45);

brep.refused: groove groove1: brep-rs supports only profiles parallel or perpendicular to the axis yet -- groove1 is shown without it.

truckFeatures.refusal: groove1 (groove): a ring with a slanted or curved side (a triangle, a circle, a rounded corner) is not built, because in the measurements the engine cut such rings wrongly or took minutes and the two cannot be told apart in advance; give the ring straight sides that are parallel and square to its axis.
